name: lying bicycle crunch
description: A lying alternating crunch that pedals the legs while the elbow meets the opposite knee. It works the abs and obliques.
instructions: Lie on your back with your hands behind your head.
Lift your shoulders and bring your knees up.
Extend one leg while turning your opposite elbow toward the other knee.
Switch sides in a smooth pedalling motion.
Keep your lower back pressed down.
